item.title: O6-type layered oxides for sustainable high-energy battery cathodes
item.content:encoded:
Nature Sustainability, Published online: 20 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01987-5

Cobalt-free cathodes are vital for green energy but suffer from structural instability. Here the authors report a unique O6-type framework that stabilizes oxygen redox for exceptional cycling durability.

item.title: Plant-derived photocatalytic carbon dots for crop disease management
item.content:encoded:
Nature Sustainability, Published online: 20 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01978-6

Plant fungal pathogens in crops can lead to substantial economic losses and pose a severe threat to food security. To tackle wheat Fusarium head blight, a devastating disease infecting wheat crops, an effective antifungal strategy using plant-derived photocatalytic carbon dots has been developed.
